Subject: Onboarding: Sycamore Labs — payment route for pilot

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We’re excited to kick off the 6-week pilot next week. Before we start, finance asked whether Redwood requires a Purchase Order to be in place for vendor onboarding, or if we can be set up on an invoice-only path for this short engagement.

Sycamore is an early-stage company and we don’t typically have procurement PO cycles that align with a one-off pilot; we can accept Net30 invoices and provide the usual vendor paperwork (W-9, bank remit). If there’s any temporary alternative or documented exception process, we’d appreciate the details so we can get set up quickly.

I’ve copied our finance inbox so they’re in the loop.

Thanks,
Sophie Allen
Senior Partnerships Manager | Sycamore Labs

Thanks Sophie — welcome aboard!

Short answer: we do prefer vendors to be onboarded with a PO for multi-month/recurring work, but we have a documented temporary "invoice-only" pathway for small pilots provided certain evidence is supplied and the engagement is capped. I’ve looped in Priya from Vendor Ops to confirm the exact requirements and intake form.

Can you send the vendor intake info + W-9 and a sample invoice? If you can also confirm an expected monthly spend ceiling for the pilot (ballpark), that’ll help us determine whether this qualifies for the temporary route.

Avery Johnson

Hi Sophie — thanks for the docs, they’re helpful. A few items we’ll need to approve the temporary invoice-only onboarding: 

- Completed vendor intake form with primary remittance contact (it looks mostly filled; please add a phone number for the AP contact).
- Valid W-9 (received) and a copy of a bank remittance page or ACH onboarding doc for verification.
- Confirmation that the pilot is single-invoice and total expected spend is <= $5,000.
- No SLA or data residency commitments beyond standard trial terms. If your pilot stores customer data or requires expanded retention, we’ll need to evaluate separately.

If all items check, Procurement can provision a temporary allowlist entry for 90 days and route invoices via AP under the invoice-only track. Conditions: one-off pilot invoices only; any repeat or multi-month commitments must transition to PO-backed onboarding.

If you prefer, we can require a single PO for this engagement — that’s also fine, but I understand it may delay start.

Priya Natarajan
Vendor Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Onboarding: Sycamore Labs — payment route for pilot

Adding final approval: Procurement is comfortable approving a temporary invoice-only onboarding for Sycamore Labs under the following binding conditions: 

1) Single invoice for the pilot (<= $5,000).
2) Vendor intake form fully completed and AP contact verified (phone + remit email).
3) W-9 and bank remit documentation on file (we have the W-9; need the remit proof).
4) 90-day temporary allowlist entry; procurement will automatically review at day 60 for any signs of recurring spend.
5) Any future recurring work or spend above $5k requires formal PO and updated vendor onboarding.

Avery/Priya: please add Sycamore to the temporary allowlist and send the DocuSign invoice routing confirmation to Sophie. Sophie: once you upload the remittance proof to the secure link, we’ll complete onboarding.

Markus Klein
Head of Procurement | Redwood Inference
